scientific.integrity: The proof starts from the defining AggMo recurrence, diagonalizes an SPD quadratic into scalar curvature modes, derives the exact modal characteristic polynomial, excludes every nonreal unit-circle crossing for positive steps, and identifies the unique boundary root at minus one. A separate sign identity for the characteristic polynomial at minus one proves necessity above the boundary.
limitations: The theorem assumes a common constant learning rate and equal averaging across velocity buffers.
It gives the exact Schur boundary but not the rate-optimal interior learning rate.
It applies to fixed symmetric positive-definite quadratic Hessians and not stochastic, nonnormal, or nonquadratic dynamics.
Extended AggMo with separate per-buffer learning rates is outside scope.

title: Exact harmonic-mean stability frontier for Aggregated Momentum
